author: dabe7
quote: This game is genuinely a masterpiece ****. Every moment feels genuine with no filler. You cant say that about modern games anymore. Not to mention the artists really cooked on the designs and art style. I love that this game feels fresh, and looks incredibly beautiful. A great game needs great music, and this game delivers! This game is timeless, the characters are loveable with admirable personalities. This game has an amazing balance of dark fantasy and fairy storybook wonderland. This game is enjoyable for all ages. Adult link really steps up the darkness and melancholy, while young link feels like you’re a storybook character. This is by far my favorite Zelda game, surpassing BOTW and TOTK. It doesn’t nearly have as much content, however it offers greater quality and shows a bright future for Zelda.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: dabe7
quote: Resident Evil Requiem is the latest installment of the series and it takes much of the feedback from past games. It offers an amazing balance of horror and action. I found myself immersed in the experience, and was some of the most fun I had. Generally speaking **** has good replayability then that says a lot about the experience. I replayed the game 3 times! I just wish there were some more creepy monsters to destroy as Leon!  I have high hopes for the future of Resident Evil.

author: dabe7
quote:
Credit where it’s due. The graphics are incredible, with beautiful scenery. However the looks are deceiving. Some aspects of the game have realism than all of a sudden are met with unrealistic physics or random events. The balance between the two are incredibly off. It doesn’t feel like a GTA game at all. The combat system and loadout system feel clunky.
It also doesn’t help that the game is locked at 30fps. It’s 2026 people!! GTA used to be a game where you could have people over and they could figure the game out pretty quick. It doesn’t have that plug and play experience. Also what’s with the obvious paid off critic reviews???? Does rockstar have no shame. It’s sad to see that some areas of the game are blocked off by paywalls as well. Overall I have to put my foot down with this game. I really hope they take the criticism and do greater things in the future.
